title: fish_passage_hourly
description: One row of the view public.fish_passage_hourly. fish_count is the number of non-rejected sonar tracks with that species and direction in that UTC hour. It is an individual-fish count (one track per fish in the beam), not calling activity. Tracks with a null species_id are omitted. Rejected tracks are omitted. hour is the UTC hour start. mean_length_cm is the mean of length_cm.

hour.description: UTC hour start from date_trunc on sonar_tracks.start_time.
